newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot has no comment on share price.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot has no comment on share price.

text.p: Home Depot Inc on Monday had no comment on its rising share price, but a spokeswoman said the retailing company had not released any news or made any investment presentation that would account for the sharp gain.

"We have made no announcements and haven't made any investor presentations. And beyond that, I wouldn't be able to comment on the stock price activity," said Kim Shreckengost, Home Depot's investor relations officer.
The stock rose 1-3/4, or 3.4 percent, to 52-5/8 in late morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Merrill Lynch's Peter Caruso later described the strength in Home Depot's shares as a simple reaction to recent price weakness.

"The thing has tumbled a lot. I mean, the stock is down from a high of 58 and it was down a point and a half on Friday. So, it's just bouncing back and forth. There's nothing dramatic going on here," he said.
